prompt: Write down some DC females characters that are young adult in comics (18-30 years old)
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 best follows the prompt by listing multiple DC female characters with plausible young-adult (18–30) portrayals, despite some minor age-range uncertainty. Candidate 3 is also mostly on-topic with DC female characters, but several entries are vague/less well-grounded and the 18–30 claim is less consistently supported. Candidate 4 includes a clear major error by listing Damian Wayne (a male character) despite the prompt asking for DC females. Candidate 2 has an even stronger failure for the same gender constraint by including Wally West (male) and inconsistently describing him as a 25–30-year-old woman.
